name: krea
description: Three Krea skills: generation workflows, professional animation production, and developer integration patterns.

interface.shortDescription: Generate, animate, and build with Krea workflow skills.
interface.longDescription: Krea AI Skills turn your agent into a Krea-native creative collaborator. krea-ai is the canonical intent-first router for image, video, enhancement, LoRA, product, campaign, and architectural visualization workflows. krea-animation adds studio-style animation production with asset bibles, storyboards, shot lists, generated clips, edit assembly, QA, and retakes. krea-build helps developers integrate Krea into their own applications.
defaultPrompt: Generate an image of a cyberpunk cat at golden hour
Render this Sketchup screenshot in photoreal evening light
Create an anime pilot workflow from this story idea
Create a hero product shot of my new perfume bottle for the homepage
Help me integrate Krea image generation into my SvelteKit app
